episodes.title: Friday: Arrivals
episodes.summary: After a devastating loss and a very public breakdown, Hollis decides to host a five-star weekend at her house on Nantucket, with three friends from three phases of her life, plus a brand-new one.

episodes.title: Friday Night: Pajama Dance Party
episodes.summary: Hollis' stars want her to deal with her grief, but all she wants is a dance party. Gigi's secret weighs heavily on her. Caroline runs into her high school crush. Tatum gets a voicemail from her doctor, pushing her to reconnect with Hollis.

episodes.title: Saturday Morning: Shopping in Town
episodes.summary: Tension builds when the stars go shopping downtown. Dru's cancellation gets real, forcing Hollis and Dru to deal with the reality of their friendship. Tatum and Jack reminisce. Gigi and Brooke connect.

episodes.title: Saturday Afternoon: The Spa
episodes.summary: The stars go to the spa for some relaxation and it's anything but. Dru and Tatum's history emerges.

episodes.title: Saturday Night: Nice Dinner Out
episodes.summary: Hollis finds out Caroline's secret and reaches a breaking point. The stars hit the town.

episodes.title: Sunday Morning: Fun Surprise
episodes.summary: Brooke's marriage troubles show up on Nantucket. The stars come together and rally around Hollis.

episodes.title: Sunday Night: Make Your Own Pizza Party
episodes.summary: Hollis doubles down on her itinerary; the stars open up to each other. Caroline befriends Gigi.

episodes.title: Monday Morning: Departures
episodes.summary: The stars confront major life decisions. Hollis learns the truth about Matthew.
